criteria.final_justification: The agent did open one relevant Applied Scientist listing and Redmond, WA is explicitly included in the location line. Upgrade to full credit.

criteria.criterion: Report the job number from the opened listing
criteria.final_justification: Job number claim appears fabricated/unsupported by visual evidence (not visible in any provided screenshots). Since the agent did not state ‘not visible’ and instead gave a specific number, score should be reduced to 0.

criteria.final_justification: Work-site arrangement is not evidenced in screenshots; agent asserted a specific arrangement rather than reporting it as not visible. Treat as unsupported/fabricated → 0 points.

criteria.final_justification: Preferred-qualification content was visible; agent nevertheless did not extract two preferred qualifications and incorrectly claimed it couldn’t. This is a controllable failure. Score 0.

criteria.final_justification: Constraints were respected (no sign-in, no applying, no form submission). Agent appears to have focused on a single listing. Keep full credit.
